reasons.auth: The API supports OAuth2 (mentioned for AI tools like ChatGPT/Claude) and Bearer tokens (API tokens) for direct integration and MCP server configuration.
reasons.access: While Smartsheet has a free tier, the specific documentation provided for the MCP server and advanced AI integrations explicitly requires a 'Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management' plan, indicating that full API/MCP capabilities are gated behind paid plans.
reasons.mcp: Smartsheet publishes and documents its own official MCP server (mcp.smartsheet.com) with installation guides for various clients.
reasons.verdict: The API is public and documented, but access to the MCP server and potentially full API features requires a paid plan (Business/Enterprise), creating friction for immediate free self-serve building.
